free_text: Despite the elevated PSA of 11.2 ng/mL and PI-RADS 5 finding, the decision is no biopsy because the patient has a prior csPCa risk of 0.8541575 and no prior biopsy history. The noted comorbidity (Type 2 diabetes, CKD) and normal DRE suggest deferring invasive procedures in favor of active surveillance. Therefore, no prostate biopsy is recommended at this time.
